summary: Full validation of Kabadi Market Hisab MVP (backend + frontend). Created pytest suite with 24 tests covering auth, categories(73), search status transitions (no stock change), buy/sell (+1/-1), purchase limit engine (STOP + override), global limit admin-only, requirements, buying-trip decisions (OK TO BUY / BUY — REQUIRED / ALREADY IN STOCK / DO NOT BUY), Gemini AI research + approve merge as Verified, inventory, demand, stats, and permissions (staff 403 on admin endpoints). All 24 backend tests PASS. Frontend tested end-to-end via Playwright mobile viewport (390x844): login → dashboard modules → SEARCH manual entry → NEW PART status → BUY confirms and part flips to IN STOCK → Inventory reflects unit → Categories screen shows 73 items in 5 collapsible groups → Admin, Users, Limits, AI Approvals, Requirements, Buying Trip screens all load correctly. No deprecated expo packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) detected. No React Native red screens. Only observation: harmless console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' emitted by an underlying library on web preview (not a functional bug).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~910 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, parts, buy_sell, ai, admin) if it grows further. Not blocking now.
AI research prompt uses gemini-3-flash-preview which is correctly per user choice; ensure future prompts guard against LLM returning fenced code (parse_json_block handles it, verified via test).
